title: Blu's Music Discs
description: Blu's Music Discs is a culmination of BluTheBerryXD's music tracks made into minecraft Music Discs.
body:
Blu's Music Discs is a culmination of BluTheBerryXD's music tracks made into minecraft Music Discs.

This was posted with permission of BluTheBerryXD herself. I am not the owner of these songs and I wont claim to be. At the moment only five songs are planned to be in this mod. As time goes by I hope to be privilaged enough to add more. Until next time!
